notes: The OCR is poor in places (garbled line-end fragments, Greek diacritics misread e.g. 'χαθ'' for 'καθ''). The Ishmaelite sentence is clean enough to read but its exact word-forms should be checked against the page image in Migne col. 1228 before publication. The letter is a penitential exhortation; the Ishmaelite (Turkish) assault is a historical explanation, not a doctrinal statement on Islam.
